page_title: BHA 0-0 BRE | Brighton v Brentford 27/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van den Berg S. Groin Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Brighton fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
88' Substitution. Joel Veltman walks off the pitch and Solly March (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
87' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
86' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Bart Verbruggen.
85' Joel Veltman (Brighton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
83' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
82' The shots on goal statistics – 7:2.
80' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
78' Thomas Frank is forced to make a change. Ben Mee (Brentford) is unable to continue due to injury, Ji-Soo Kim comes on.
78' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Julio Enciso is replaced by Georginio Rutter (Brighton).
78' Looks like Ben Mee (Brentford) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
77' No action against Joao Pedro (Brighton), and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Andy Madley got that spot on. VAR seen to good effect there!

77' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Joao Pedro (Brighton) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
75' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
74' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
72' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Christian Norgaard will be replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
72' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
71' The corner from Julio Enciso (Brighton) is cleared away by the defence.
70' Julio Enciso (Brighton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
67' Today's match ends for Matt O'Riley who will be replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brajan Gruda leaves the pitch and Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) comes on.
67' Here is a change. Kaoru Mitoma is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Simon Adingra (Brighton).
65' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner with a short pass.
65' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
63' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
63' Kevin Schade (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Brentford will have an opportunity.
60' A pass by Julio Enciso (Brighton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball has crossed the sideline. Brentford are taking a throw-in.
59' Joao Pedro (Brighton) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Mark Flekken makes a smart save to deny him.
58' The shot by Joao Pedro (Brighton) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mark Flekken.
57' Ben Mee (Brentford) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
57' A first-time shot by Yoane Wissa (Brentford) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
56' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is flagged for offside.
55' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off the line to clear the ball away.
55' The foul by Brajan Gruda (Brighton) was seen by Andy Madley who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
49' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
49' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Ben Mee (Brentford) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
45+2' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
44' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
42' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' Julio Enciso (Brighton) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' Julio Enciso (Brighton) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post.
39' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
36' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hakon Rafn Valdimarsson is coming onto the pitch as Mark Flekken (Brentford) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
35' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
33' Mark Flekken (Brentford) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' The game is interrupted now, Mark Flekken (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Fine attempt! Julio Enciso (Brighton) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
30' The current number of shots on goal is 5:0.
27' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mark Flekken comes off the line to clear the ball away.

24' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Mark Flekken makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner.
22' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

20' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Flekken denies him with a great save.
18' Brighton are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
17' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) and Ben Mee matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
15' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Brentford due to an offside in the build-up play.
15' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Brentford players aren’t happy.

14' GOAL! Superb work from Mads Roerslev Rasmussen, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who beats Bart Verbruggen with a brilliant shot into the top left corner. 0:1.

13' What a save from Mark Flekken! Julio Enciso (Brighton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
12' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
10' Poor challenge! Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is penalised for tripping and Andy Madley blows his whistle.
8' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared.
8' A snap shot by Carlos Baleba (Brighton) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken produces a good save to thwart him.
7' Julio Enciso (Brighton) tries to find Joao Pedro, but he puts too much power on the pass.
7' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.

5' OFF THE POST! Julio Enciso (Brighton) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
3' The ball is cleared after Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Brentford will kick the game off.
Andy Madley was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
